# Dome and Hatch Light Upgrades

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Run wires from the cargo or dome circuit in parallel with new LED lights. [t905]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Identify the cargo light or dome light circuit that acts as a power source.
2. [Partial] Run wires from this source to connect with new LED lights in parallel.
3. [Partial] Ensure positive and negative connections do not short against existing metal housings.

_Procedure reported by [t905]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Use an ON-OFF-ON switch if mimicking a dome light setup for three positions of operation. [t905]
- Note that 2004 models may have specific wiring, but the concept applies to later years as well. [t905]
